description: Na₂MgCl₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbam space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.77-2.92 Å. Mg is bonded to six Cl atoms to form edge-sharing MgCl₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.46 Å) and four longer (2.56 Å) Mg-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Mg atoms to form distorted ClNa₂Mg₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with eight equivalent ClNa₄Mg trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent ClNa₂Mg₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ClNa₄Mg trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ClNa₂Mg₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Mg atom to form distorted ClNa₄Mg trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent ClNa₄Mg trigonal bipyramids, corners with eight equivalent ClNa₂Mg₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four equivalent ClNa₄Mg trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ClNa₂Mg₂ trigonal pyramids.
